newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Germany's Herzog arrives in Hungary for 3-day visit.
newsitem.headline: Germany's Herzog arrives in Hungary for 3-day visit.

text.p: German president Roman Herzog arrived in Hungary on Tuesday to begin a three-day visit.
Herzog will meet Hungary's government and business leaders and leading academics, and will visit the German speaking Schwab community in the village of Solymar, near Budapest.
He will also meet representatives of other ethnic minorities and on Tuesday will visit the Budapest synagogue, the largest in Europe.
The German president will end his visit on Thursday by touring Hungary's economically depressed Eastern region centred around the towns of Nyiregyhaza and Debrecen.
